correctness.rationale: Substituting the scalar quadratic into the published Remark 2.9 update gives \(\ell_k=L_k=\lambda\) exactly. The two algebraic identities \(r^3-r-1=0\) and \(2ra^2-2a-r=0\) force alternating branch choices and hence the exact period-two normalized steps. The resulting scalar iterate recurrence gives the stated Q-linear closed form; all denominators remain nonzero because \(1<a<b<2\) and \(x^0\ne0\).
